title: Cyber Security — monitoring, security review, incident response and infrastructure protection
description: Cybersecurity from ThatDeveloperGuy LLC: security monitoring, human security review, incident response planning and infrastructure protection.
heading: Cyber Security
summary: Detect, protect, respond — with a human reading the results.

sections.heading: Security monitoring overview
sections.body: The threat map and the 100% readout in the room are illustration. Monitoring in practice is scoped to what a client runs and reported in plain language.

sections.heading: Security review and system health
sections.body: A person reads the configuration, the exposure and the logs, and writes down what should change and why.

sections.heading: Incident response planning
sections.body: Who is called, what is isolated, what is preserved, who is told — decided before an incident, rehearsed after.

sections.heading: Infrastructure protection
sections.body: Patching, segmentation, backups that restore, and access that is granted on purpose.

sections.heading: Security review process
sections.body: Scope, collect, read, report, remediate, re-check.
